items.english: It was in a faintly dim light, and, quiet like that light, three people drawing close with their heads together were telling a long story. That story seemed to go on and on between them without ever breaking. And within that story it seemed that everything in the world was being told — good and evil, sorrow and suffering and anger and worry, joy, everything. But teller and listener alike only went on smiling, quietly and peacefully and motionlessly, and they did not move at all. With heads inclined, gazing down, and there it looked as if only a quiet dearness and forgiveness wrapped them. And there too a deep, deep peace showed upon all of them.
notes: p16-s1淡暗い kept as faintly dim to hold dimness without making it lyrical; s4微笑 rendered as smiling to keep smile network steady across feeding noise and vision.

items.english: All things of the world, a life, would pass into the past. And only on the day they had passed would everything, all things, change into dearness and forgiveness. And then they would be forever before a night-like rest.
notes: p17-s1過去る is archaic/historical-kana made-verb for passing into the past; kept as pass into the past rather than pass away to avoid death clarification. s3安息 kept as rest to keep peace/rest pair distinct but linked.

items.english: The far picture lay dark and silent at the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far off in the future, with a lonely peace, that picture was to be seen. Young, she gave a lonely secret sigh alone, and glancing at the littered top of the {t:table} and at the faces of her husband and child, she stayed silent.
notes: p18-s2 keeps lonely peace together without softening; s2-s3 far, lonely, silent repeated as network words, no added thought-tags.

data.say: Drafted p16-p18 as unbroken circling vision with network words held steady.
